topics.title: The AAA similarity test for triangles

questions.stem: In the diagram, \(\triangle ABC\)\(\lvert\rvert\lvert\rvert\)\(\triangle XYZ\), as shown.

parts.hint: Two pairs of matching angles are marked equal in each triangle.

steps.explain: Two angles are marked as equal between the triangles: \(25°=25°\) and \(34°=34°\).
If two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of another, the triangles are similar (the third angles must also be equal, by the angle sum of a triangle).

meta.source: Sydney Grammar School Form III Annual Examination 2022

parts.stem: Hence calculate the length \(XY\), given \(AB=8\text{ cm}\), \(BC=6\text{ cm}\), \(YZ=9\text{ cm}\) (with \(A\leftrightarrow X\), \(B\leftrightarrow Y\), \(C\leftrightarrow Z\)).
parts.hint: Find the scale factor using the matching sides \(BC\) and \(YZ\) (both opposite the \(25°\) angle), then apply it to \(AB\).

steps.explain: Since \(A\leftrightarrow X\), \(B\leftrightarrow Y\), \(C\leftrightarrow Z\), side \(BC\) corresponds to side \(YZ\). Use this known pair to find the scale factor.
Side \(AB\) corresponds to side \(XY\). Multiply \(AB\) by the scale factor.

meta.source: Sydney Grammar School Form III Annual Examination 2022
